title: Squared-off object tumbles into the back pasture at the country house

tellings.quote: this object that was squared off came tumbling across the sky and went into the back pasture behind the house.

plain: In the 1950s, at his family's country house in Texas, the writer Whitley Strieber says, a square-edged object came tumbling across the sky and fell into the field behind the house. Strieber tells Michels it as something from his own childhood, "this object that was squared off came tumbling across the sky and went into the back pasture," and he mentions a man named Karl Strieber in the story. If true, it would be an early brush with a crashed craft in his family's life.
